blockingLoop.evidence: Final turn repeats the drain-cycle instruction verbatim ('Did the water pump away this time?') after the customer said they hadn't run it and asked a direct question.

rationale: The customer repeatedly asked whether a cupful of clean water in the sump is normal, and the evidence (new unit, clean water, no codes, not rising, tub empty) clearly pointed to normal sump water. The assistant never answered, kept escalating invasive checks (pump cover, hose, blanking plug) and ended by repeating the drain-cycle instruction verbatim. It ignored the customer's reluctance and gave no reassurance, so the homeowner was poorly served despite no unsafe or part-related errors.
